notes: The outer full-image gradient canvas and large rounded white frame are ignored presentation wrappers.
The page root is the internal Vyra dashboard product surface; it does not recreate the outer frame border, radius, shadow, or artboard padding.
Charts, progress bars, background data texture, and scan portrait are implemented as structured DOM/SVG/CSS.

scroll_architecture.desktop: Full-page dashboard product surface. The browser document scrolls only when the viewport is shorter than the dashboard composition.
scroll_architecture.mobile: Cards collapse into a single column with normal document scrolling and wrapped top controls.

shadow_mapping.cards: Flat white surfaces with subtle border and xs shadow.
shadow_mapping.controls: Translucent controls use conservative inset highlights.
shadow_mapping.ignored_wrappers: No outer frame shadow or rounded frame is rendered.
